claim: Pre-CoT token-confidence AUROC averages 0.644 for OPD, 0.594 Instruct, 0.526 SFT, 0.320 RL; RL is below 0.5 on all four benchmarks.
quoted_support: Qwen-OPD achieves the strongest overall Pre-CoT calibration, with the highest average AUROC of 0.644 and the highest average PRR of 0.345.

breadth.confidence_families: token-level predictive statistics (top-k mean negative log-prob), group confidence, PosConf (Sec 3)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: Qwen-Instruct reference vs post-trained variants; no base-model pair
breadth.post_training_stages: SFT, RL (GRPO), OPD (on-policy distillation) controlled from same backbone/data (Intro, Sec 4)
breadth.reasoning_models: reasoning-oriented post-trained variants with CoT; Instruct as non-reasoning reference
breadth.elicitation_formats: token-probability only; limitation says other signals left to future work
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUROC, PRR (Table 1), accuracy vs token budget
breadth.causal_intervention: post-training comparison under fixed data (training-level, not activation-level)

claim: Post-CoT: confidence-filtered voting helps RL (Top-10% avg 62.8, +5.4 over majority vote 57.4) but not SFT or OPD, whose confidence-based strategies underperform majority vote.
quoted_support: Qwen-RL benefits the most from confidence filtering: its Top-10% confidence voting reaches an average accuracy of 62.8%, improving over its own majority-vote baseline by 5.4 percentage points.
